blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Taxes can sound hard. But in English, they follow simple patterns. Today you write your first tax report. Do not worry — one step at a time.

Sophie helps the team. She explains the tax words slowly, in simple English. She says taxes are just one more part of the company's routine. The report must be correct before we send the form.

There is a new summary on the tax calendar this month. The last month is ready for the accountant to review. We check every number before the deadline. You can do it!

items.q: Who helps the team with the tax words?
items.why: "Sophie helps the team. She explains the tax words slowly."

items.q: How does Sophie explain the tax words?
items.why: "She explains the tax words slowly, in simple English."

items.q: What must happen before we send the form?
items.why: "The report must be correct before we send the form."

items.q: The text says "one step at a time." This suggests that…
options: the report is easy if you go slowly
you must finish in one minute
items.why: Inferência: a mensagem é calma — devagar, um passo por vez, você consegue.

items.q: Sophie would most likely DISAGREE with which sentence?
options: We check the numbers before the deadline.
Taxes in English are too hard to learn.
Taxes are part of the routine.
items.why: Inferência: o texto todo diz que os impostos seguem padrões simples — ela discordaria de que são difíceis demais.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie ajudar o aluno a escrever o relatório. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! I am Sophie, and today we write your first tax report together. Do not worry. It is short and simple.

First, we write the summary. The summary is one small paragraph. It says what we did last month. For example: "Last month, we sent the form on time." That is one good sentence.

Next, we look at this month. This month, we have a new number on the tax calendar. So we write: "This month, we check every number before the deadline." Simple and clear.

Then, we think about next month. Next month, the report stays in the fiscal folder. We keep it safe for seven years. You can write: "Next month, we start the new report."

See? Three small sentences. Last month, this month, next month. That is your report. Read it one more time. If it is correct, we send it. Good work today. One step at a time — you did it!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What do Sophie and the student write today?
items.why: "today we write your first tax report together."

items.q: What does the summary say?
items.why: "The summary is one small paragraph. It says what we did last month."

items.q: How long do we keep the report in the fiscal folder?
items.why: "We keep it safe for seven years."

items.q: Sophie divides the report into three parts. This suggests she wants the student to…
options: feel that the report is small and easy
items.why: Inferência: dividir em três frases curtas mostra que o objetivo é deixar simples e possível.

items.q: How would you best describe Sophie's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ela repete "do not worry", "you can do it", "one step at a time" — tom calmo e encorajador.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I send the tax report to the accountant." A report is…
items.why: Report = relatório: um documento escrito com informações.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ is a short paragraph at the top of the report."
items.why: Summary = resumo: o parágrafo curto no topo do relatório.

items.q: "Last month, we sent the form on time." Last month means…
items.why: Last month = mês passado, o mês antes de agora.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "___, we check every number before the deadline." (the current month)
items.why: This month = este mês, o mês em que estamos agora.

items.q: "Next month, we start a new report." Next month means…
items.why: Next month = mês que vem, o mês depois de agora.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager must sign off on the report." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o "ok" final.

items.q: "We fill in the tax form every month." To fill in a form means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher, escrever as informações no formulário.

items.q: "Please check over the numbers before we send it." To check over means to…
items.why: Check over = revisar, olhar com atenção.

items.q: "We agreed on the plan, but we did not follow through." This means we…
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.

items.q: "We must hand in the report before the deadline." To hand in means to…
options: give it to the right person
items.why: Hand in = entregar, dar o documento a quem deve receber.
